admission.justification: A future review adapter must not fabricate a missing knowledge half or turn unavailable/unselected knowledge into a favorable comparison.

applicability: The four-tree reviewer paired-review boundary chosen in MIK-R57@v2 appendix83/151 and rule6.
conditions: A selected knowledge subject is compared only through resolved paired code/memory endpoints; source-only task context remains a distinct answer with no compared knowledge operand.
exclusions: No claim that a task-context source review disappears, that legacy-unavailable means an empty converted tree, or that independent requests share one permanent snapshot.
statement: A review compares paired code and memory trees rather than inventing an unpaired knowledge judgment.
